events.invalidation: A spot expression appears only if a later daily close leaves a single breakout or failed breakout with a side and states the prior close-range level on the adverse side plus a farther target. Until that daily-close level exists, the book stays flat.
events.rationale: The latest daily closes show a cluster of Australian-dollar breakouts, short the base in Aussie-Swiss and Aussie-Sweden and long the base in sterling-Aussie, plus a separate kiwi-Canada breakout. Kiwi-Norway is a failed breakout with no side. Australian-kiwi still carries a large z-score, so the two dollars are not one chart. No name has a confirmed adverse daily-close level that would let reward exceed risk, and the research recommendations are empty. Nothing is opened.
